entities.summary: Frederick A. Meyer IV is an American former professional ice hockey defenseman who played parts of seven seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Philadelphia Flyers, New York Islanders, Phoenix Coyotes, and Atlanta Thrashers. He is currently the head coach for The Rivers School of the Independent School League (ISL), where he coached his two sons Freddy Meyer IV and Carter Meyer.
